svg.title: What goes in a moisture barrier bag
svg.desc: Not to scale. A moisture barrier bag, heat-sealed across the top, holding a reel of parts, a desiccant pouch and a humidity indicator card with three spots marked 5%, 10% and 60%, all blue (dry). A moisture-sensitivity caution label on the outside gives the level, the floor life and the seal date. A note says to push the air out but not to vacuum-seal tight.

g.text: Better than tape, which can peel
Fresh each time the bag is resealed
A spot turns pink when that humidity is passed
Push the air out, but don't vacuum-seal tight:
the desiccant needs some air to work.
Use a bag made for electronics: moisture barrier
